name: wds_vtab-dtd
description: wds_vtab-dtd is a vision benchmark that evaluates model performance on the Describable Textures Dataset (DTD) as formatted for the VTAB / WebDataset (wds) evaluation splits. It measures models' ability to classify texture patterns and surface properties across a diverse set of texture classes, typically using standard supervised evaluation. The dataset is used to probe generalization and feature representation quality for texture recognition tasks.
reputation: A niche member of the VTAB-style evaluation family used in vision research to test texture classification and transfer learning; modest community adoption.
